rule_title: TTP T1562.001 - Defender ThreatDefaultAction Allow Confirmed via EID 4103 ParameterBinding
description: High-confidence detection of the ThreatDefaultAction Allow technique via EID 4103 Module Logging ParameterBinding, which resolves the numeric value 6 to the string 'Allow'. The EID 4103 Payload field contains the fully resolved parameter names and values as bound by PowerShell's parameter binder — meaning even if the attacker passed '6' as an integer, the log records 'Allow'. Matching on 'value="Allow"' in the Payload with ThreatDefaultAction as the parameter name is definitively malicious with no legitimate equivalent.
